# What are your Kubernetes manifests handing to the node?

> Paste your Kubernetes YAML and find risky pod security settings: privileged: true, hostNetwork, hostPath docker.sock, SYS_ADMIN capabilities, running as root, missing securityContext, :latest images, literal secrets. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [Kubernetes pod security: privileged, hostPath, root and how to fix each](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/k8s-pod-security-check/what-is-kubernetes-pod-security.html)
